transition_rules.SMASH CUT: hard cut, preceding audio cut dead 2 frames early
transition_rules.MATCH CUT: align matching shapes to the same screen position
transition_rules.WHIP PAN: 6-frame motion-blur whip, cut hidden at blur peak
transition_rules.ZOOM THROUGH: push into an object and cut inside it at maximum scale, 8 frames
transition_rules.CUT TO END CARD: hard cut on the music's final downbeat

conform: Trim or time-stretch (max ±8%) each animated clip to its exact duration; never change scene order.
color_grade: Deep indigo night throughout with a hot white-gold daylight seam; the seam is the brightest element until it closes in SC9, after which the frame goes calm silver-blue.

mix.music_bed: Music sits at about -20 LUFS short-term under busy SFX, rises to -14 in music-led moments.
mix.sfx_priority: Story SFX always on top; duck music 4-6 dB for 300 ms around each key SFX hit.
mix.notes: Keep the fabric-rip SFX identical every time so it becomes a motif.

editor_notes: SC8 is a vertical ascent - use a continuous upward track; stitch two clips if needed.
SC10 dissolve to SC11 over 12 frames as Pip floats down.
Final shot - hold on the synchronized blink, cut on the downbeat.
captions: None. Do not add subtitles or text overlays (no dialogue exists).
